newsitem.title: MONACO: TENNIS-ATP TO STAY IN MONACO.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ATP TO STAY IN MONACO.

text.p: The ATP Tour said on Saturday its headquarters would not move to London but would remain in Monaco.
Tour spokesman Peer Zebergs said the board of directors had decided in Hanover last November that the office might move to London.
"(But) we learnt that many people of the staff will not move to London," he said.
About 50 players also live in Monaco.
The idea of moving had been put forward by American players who felt London was easier to get to.
